title: Verdict and Autopsy
author: Lior Pemberton
blurb: Ansel Zhou, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
